notes_for_editor: Thin record. The FFLA list is undated and gives no builder, build date, height, design or NHLR number. The only history is a 1963 map description on Pastmaps, a secondary site, not the map itself. The reservation status comes from that 1963 description alone; confirm current land status and access rules before any visit. No photos found. Staffing, fire history and current condition are unknown. Access is left out of facts because no current source gives it. Story now uses the description's wording (reservation lands dominate the survey), hedges the tribal-access point, and drops the NHLR expansion, which the list does not define.
